outcome: Access to educational, medical, and therapeutic services
cohort: The study included caregivers of children and adolescents with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) between 19 months and 18 years from the SPARK cohort.
finding: Younger children, children from low-income families, and children with greater impairment severity were more negatively impacted by the pandemic through service disruptions, increased ASD-related behaviors, negative parent/family health impacts, and found online interactions less beneficial.
cross-section timing: At the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic
